regionalInsight.title: Chandigarh (Lok Sabha) Civic Context
regionalInsight.historicalFact: India's first planned city post-independence designed by Swiss-French architect Le Corbusier, internationally celebrated for the Capitol Complex, Rock Garden, and Sukhna Lake.
regionalInsight.currentChallenge: Major civic priorities include peak-hour traffic decongestion at entry roundabouts, 24/7 smart water metering, and solid waste processing at Dadumajra.
